description: Verify domain ownership when demopage_status reports the demo link is waiting because the sign-up email is not on the product's domain (for example, Gmail). Returns the exact one-line verification file (/.well-known/demopage-verify.txt) and checks whether it is published; once detected, the live demo link turns on immediately without manual review.
name: demopage_verify_site
title: Verify website domain ownership to activate demo link
